nodes.label: Validation: Unapplied Transforms in Export Script
nodes.norm_label: validation: unapplied transforms in export script
nodes.rationale: Detect fbx_export/export_scene.fbx/gltf_export without transform_apply; fix with bpy.ops.object.transform_apply.

nodes.label: Validation: Godot Not Generating Collision Shape
nodes.norm_label: validation: godot not generating collision shape

nodes.label: Validation: Unity Calculating Normals Instead of Importing
nodes.norm_label: validation: unity calculating normals instead of importing
nodes.rationale: Import normals from file to preserve artist intent for hard/soft edges.

nodes.label: Validation: Unity Non-Standard Scale Factor
nodes.rationale: Non-1.0 globalScale indicates a pipeline/export issue being compensated for.

nodes.label: Validation: Non-Power-of-Two Texture Dimensions
nodes.rationale: Power-of-two textures for optimal GPU memory and mipmap generation.

nodes.label: Validation: Unreal Using Complex Collision
nodes.rationale: Render mesh as collision is expensive; use UCX_ simplified or convex collision.

nodes.label: Validation: Unreal LOD Not Using Auto Compute
nodes.norm_label: validation: unreal lod not using auto compute
nodes.rationale: Hero asset LODs should have explicit screen sizes rather than auto-computed.

nodes.label: Validation: Missing LOD Suffix on LOD Meshes
nodes.norm_label: validation: missing lod suffix on lod meshes

nodes.label: Validation: No N-gon Check Before Export
nodes.norm_label: validation: no n-gon check before export

nodes.label: Validation: Missing Normals Recalculation
nodes.rationale: Geometry ops (mirror, boolean, extrude...) must be followed by normals_make_consistent.

nodes.label: Validation: Missing Merge by Distance After Boolean
nodes.norm_label: validation: missing merge by distance after boolean

nodes.label: Anti-pattern: Dense Topology Where Not Needed
nodes.norm_label: anti-pattern: dense topology where not needed

nodes.label: Hard Surface Modeling Workflow
nodes.rationale: Non-destructive modifier stack (Mirror, Array, Boolean, Bevel, Weighted Normal, Triangulate, Subdivision); Exact boolean solver; weight-based bevels.

nodes.label: High to Low Poly Baking
nodes.rationale: Transfer sculpt detail via normal/AO/curvature bakes; transforms applied, _high/_low/_cage naming, non-overlapping UVs, cage fully encompassing high poly.

nodes.label: Organic Sculpting Workflow
nodes.rationale: Three phases: primary forms (subdiv 1-2), secondary (3-4), tertiary detail (5-7); plan retopology during sculpt via polygroups/polypaint.

nodes.label: Anti-pattern: Overlapping UVs for Unique Bakes
nodes.norm_label: anti-pattern: overlapping uvs for unique bakes

nodes.label: Retopology Best Practices
nodes.rationale: Manual retopo for faces, joints and blend shapes; automatic (ZRemesher, Quad Remesher) acceptable for props and background assets.

nodes.label: Texel Density Standards
nodes.rationale: Texel Density = Texture Resolution / World Size; hero chars 10.24 px/cm, NPCs 5.12, environment 2.56.

nodes.label: Topology for Deformation
nodes.rationale: Edge loops must follow muscle flow and joint rotation axes; min 3 loops per joint (5 for 180-degree bends); poles go in low-deformation areas, never at joints/lips/eyes.

nodes.label: UV Unwrapping Strategy
nodes.rationale: Maximize texture resolution, hide seams in creases/material boundaries, keep consistent texel density; padding scales with texture resolution.

nodes.label: Automatic UV Unwrap Is for Prototyping Only
nodes.norm_label: automatic uv unwrap is for prototyping only
nodes.rationale: Auto UV tools are fine for prototyping but lazy for production; Substance Painter can't fix bad UVs.

nodes.label: Bad Topology Matters More Than Poly Count
nodes.norm_label: bad topology matters more than poly count
nodes.rationale: A clean 5k tri model beats a messy 3k tri model; high poly counts aren't the enemy, bad topology at any count is.

nodes.label: Non-Destructive Workflows
nodes.rationale: Non-destructive workflows save careers; if a boolean result needs cleanup, the boolean approach was wrong.

nodes.label: Texel Density Consistency
nodes.rationale: Texel density inconsistency is the mark of amateur work; a team had to redo an LOD pipeline when QA rejected unstandardized texel density.

nodes.label: Export Pipeline Standards
nodes.rationale: Universal pre-export checklist (transforms applied, scale 1, outward normals, no n-gons, no non-manifold); FBX for Unreal/Unity, glTF for Godot/web, USD for film.

nodes.label: Export Format Selection (FBX, glTF, OBJ, USD)
nodes.norm_label: export format selection (fbx, gltf, obj, usd)

nodes.label: LOD Creation Strategy
nodes.rationale: LOD chain 100/50/25/12/5%; silhouette edges never removed; automatic LOD for static props, manual for characters, weapons, vehicles, hero props.

nodes.label: Anti-pattern: Modeling with N-gons
nodes.rationale: N-gons cause subdivision artifacts, inconsistent triangulation, shading discontinuities and unpredictable deformation.

nodes.label: Asset Naming Conventions
nodes.rationale: [Prefix]_[AssetName]_[Variant]_[LOD/Type]; SM_/SK_/T_/M_ prefixes, single-letter texture suffixes, _LOD# suffixes; version-control friendly names.

nodes.label: fixMaterial()
nodes.rationale: Memoizes via the 'fixed' Map so each shared material and its textures are built once.

nodes.label: solids collision boxes
nodes.rationale: Axis-aligned boxes of meshes between knee (0.25 m) and head (1.7 m) height; glass and curtains (NO_COLLIDE) excluded.

nodes.label: Evening dusk lighting rig (Sky, low orange sun, warm interior lights)
nodes.norm_label: evening dusk lighting rig (sky, low orange sun, warm interior lights)
nodes.rationale: Dusk sky with the last orange sun on the horizon; warm point/spot lights in the same layout as the renders carry the room; AgX tone mapping at low exposure.

nodes.label: First-person controls (WASD + pointer lock, drag fallback, touch joystick)
nodes.norm_label: first-person controls (wasd + pointer lock, drag fallback, touch joystick)

nodes.label: Room facts (5.0 m long, 3.10 m deep, 2.51 m ceiling)
nodes.norm_label: room facts (5.0 m long, 3.10 m deep, 2.51 m ceiling)

nodes.label: In-memory glTF JSON to GLB rebuild
nodes.norm_label: in-memory gltf json to glb rebuild
nodes.rationale: The model ships as glTF JSON with its binary buffer base64-embedded; the page streams it with progress, decodes the buffer, packs JSON and BIN chunks into a GLB ArrayBuffer and hands it to GLTFLoader.parse.

nodes.label: Always Apply Scale and Rotation Before Export
nodes.norm_label: always apply scale and rotation before export
nodes.rationale: Battle scar: lost 3 days because a client FBX had scale 0.01, discovered only after baking.

nodes.label: Quads Required for Deforming Meshes
nodes.rationale: Quads are a requirement for anything that deforms; triangles OK only intentionally on static hard surface; n-gons never acceptable in final production geometry.

nodes.label: Reference System Usage
nodes.rationale: Reference files are treated as source of truth: patterns.md for creation, sharp_edges.md for diagnosis, validations.md for review; user requests conflicting with them are corrected.

nodes.label: canvasTex()
nodes.rationale: Procedural canvas textures for materials Blender kept as node setups; UVs are in metres so repeat = 1/metres.

nodes.label: fixMaterialOnce()
nodes.rationale: Drops Blender bump-derived normal maps (they break lighting), applies procedural textures and decor swaps by material name, replaces glass and sheer curtain with transparent materials.

nodes.label: Selected decors: U750 ST9 Taupe Grey, H1180 ST37 Natural Halifax Oak, F226 ST78 Sand Beige Titanite
nodes.norm_label: selected decors: u750 st9 taupe grey, h1180 st37 natural halifax oak, f226 st78 sand beige titanite
nodes.rationale: Walkthrough-only remap of Blender materials (U961 Graphite, RT1522 OR, walnut H7586) to the chosen cabinet, oak and worktop decors; also shown as swatches in the info panel.

nodes.label: Ponytail levels (lite, full, ultra)
nodes.rationale: lite builds what was asked and names the smaller option; full applies the rules (default); ultra also pushes back on unjustified parts of the request.

nodes.label: Shortcut comment convention
nodes.rationale: A shortcut with a known limit gets a comment 'shortcut: <the limit>, <when to upgrade>'.

nodes.label: Before you write: scope check
nodes.rationale: List every place the change must reach (callers, tests, fixtures, config, exports) and what it could break for users; that is scope, extra features are not.

nodes.label: Never-cut list
nodes.rationale: Validation at trust boundaries, error handling preventing data loss, security, accessibility, hardware calibration and anything the user asked for are never cut for brevity.

nodes.label: Lazy code needs a self-check
nodes.rationale: New non-trivial logic leaves one small test or assert-based self-check; trivial changes need none.

nodes.label: Smallest complete change ladder
nodes.rationale: Take the first option that fully works: skip unasked features, reuse codebase helpers, then stdlib/platform, then installed deps, then a one-liner, else minimum code. Be lazy about the solution, never about completing the change (callers, tests, fixtures).

nodes.label: Modular Asset Workflow
nodes.rationale: Grid-based reusable pieces that snap together seamlessly; model in target engine units from the start; matching edges need identical vertex counts.

nodes.label: /graphify trigger rule
nodes.rationale: When the user types /graphify, the installed graphify skill must be used before doing anything else; turns any input into a knowledge graph.
